content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a [product_name] with article number [article_no]. If I am correct, it has 4 onboard analog inputs. I want to connect temperature sensors directly to it. Can someone advise what type or brand of temperature sensor is compatible, or provide a [url] where I can order one? My power supply is 24VDC.
The onboard analog inputs of the base module accept 0-10V signals. So you will need temperature sensors with external transmitters that output 0-10V or 0/4-20mA signals.
Thanks. Could you please provide an example of a compatible sensor type, and share guidance on how to wire it?
Unfortunately, I cannot provide a specific example because I am not sure which sensor you intend to use.

Apologies, my hardware knowledge is limited. I need a concrete example of a sensor that would work. I have read about two-wire and three-wire sensors, and external power requirements. My setup includes a 24VDC power supply and I am looking for a 0-10V temperature sensor. Sorry for all the questions.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are requesting practical advice on selecting and wiring temperature sensors compatible with the onboard analog inputs of a specific [product_name] module. The absence of accessible documentation or clear recommendations causes uncertainty, especially among those less confident with hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to receive concrete examples of suitable temperature sensors that work with [product_name] analog inputs and clear wiring instructions.
